text_simplified: The family must embody firmness in regulating the times children return home, because leniency leads to the disintegration of relationships and the waste of effort and time. Righteous parents have a profound impact in raising their children upon goodness and guidance. It is mentioned in the Qur’an and Sunnah that the righteousness of children and their birr al-walidayn (filial piety) elevate their ranks in Paradise. Some people mistakenly believe their actions have no effect, but there are many examples that prove the opposite. Truthfulness and adherence to true words and deeds are the foundation of interaction. The Prophet ﷺ warned against lying, betraying amanah (trust), and breaking promises.
